component.name: Lumen
component.summary: A fast, safe viewer and editor for pictures and PDFs

description.p: Lumen opens pictures and PDFs quickly and keeps them safe. It is written in pure Rust, with no C code in the document path, and decodes pictures in a sandboxed process.
View pictures and PDFs, flip through a folder, search and select text, fill in forms, draw and highlight, sign, turn and crop pictures, organise PDF pages, and print.

ul.li: PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, TIFF, BMP, JPEG XL, JPEG 2000, OpenEXR, SVG and more, with animation
PDF reading with contents, search, links, forms and password-protected files
Markup saved as real PDF annotations, and handwritten signatures
Page organiser, export to PNG or PDF, night mode, slideshow

description.p: First release: pictures, PDFs, markup, forms, signatures, picture editing, page organising, export, printing, slideshow, preferences, sandboxed decoding, Spanish translation.
